summary: This note covers the ninth British series of the reality television programme Ex on the Beach, which began airing on 15 August 2018. The series was confirmed at the end of the eighth series final episode in May 2018, and its cast was announced on 23 July 2018. It was filmed at the luxury villa Playaakun in Tulum, Mexico, and featured exes given more power than ever, with the 'Tablet of Terror' continuing to throw twists at them.
one_line: The ninth British series of reality show Ex on the Beach, premiering August 2018 and filmed at Playaakun villa in Tulum, Mexico.
